title_en: Why Is the Tradwife Fantasy So Seductive?
title_zh: 为什么“传统妻子”的幻想如此迷人？
dek_en: Domestic fantasy, hidden labour, platform commerce, and the politics of returning home.
dek_zh: 家庭幻想、隐形劳动、平台商业与“回归家庭”的政治。

research_question.question_en: When Tradwife culture is packaged as a lifestyle, a personal choice, and a route out of modern pressure, what exactly is it selling to women?
research_question.question_zh: 当 Tradwife 被包装成一种生活方式、一种个人选择和一条逃离现代压力的路径时，它究竟在向女性出售什么？
research_question.trigger_en: Long dresses, fresh bread, immaculate kitchens, many children, and time apparently untouched by commutes or email have become a recurring social-media vision. Yet homemaking, Tradwife aesthetics, Tradwife identity, Tradwife ideology, and far-right Tradwife politics are not interchangeable categories.
research_question.trigger_zh: 长裙、刚出炉的面包、整洁的厨房、成群的孩子，以及仿佛不受通勤和电子邮件打扰的时间，已经成为社交媒体上反复出现的画面。但家庭主妇、Tradwife美学、Tradwife身份、Tradwife意识形态与极右翼Tradwife政治，并不是可以互换的概念。
research_question.purpose_en: This report tests a working thesis: Tradwife culture turns structural exhaustion into an individualized fantasy of return. It asks why the fantasy feels comforting, which forms of labour it hides, how platforms commercialize it, when lifestyle becomes politics, and where the evidence contradicts a simple radicalization story.
research_question.purpose_zh: 本专题检验一个工作假设：Tradwife文化把结构性的疲惫转化成一场个人化的回归幻想。我们追问这种幻想为何令人安心、它隐藏了哪些劳动、平台如何将其商业化、生活方式何时成为政治，以及哪些证据反驳了简单的激进化叙事。

news.heading_en: What does the Tradwife fantasy promise—and what disappears outside the frame?
news.heading_zh: Tradwife幻想承诺了什么，又有哪些现实被移出画面？

blocks.heading_zh: 在成为主张之前，它首先是一种感觉
paragraphs_en: Tradwife content first works as a feeling rather than a policy claim. Dough rises on a wooden table; sunlight falls across linen and copper pans; a mother calmly prepares food for her children. The frame lowers the volume of modern life and presents the home as a small, controllable world. It sells emotional certainty: life has rhythm, labour has visible results, and everyone seems to have a clear place.

Kate Scott and Lindsay Day conducted a qualitative content analysis of 102 TikTok posts from 61 creators who presented themselves as Tradwives. They found traditional femininity, religious submission, motherhood, reproductive futurity, and colonial nostalgia appearing together through image, sound, and language. The researchers coded 85.2% of creators in the sample as white, while 26% of videos featured small hobby farms. This non-random sample cannot represent TikTok or prove audience effects; it shows how a defined group of posts produces domestic life as a seemingly natural and peaceful ideal.

The fantasy resonates because dissatisfaction is real. The 2024 American Time Use Survey found that among adults living with children under six, women spent an average of three hours a day on primary childcare, compared with two hours for men. These data do not identify Tradwife viewers or explain every household, but they show that care remains unevenly distributed.
paragraphs_zh: Tradwife内容的第一重力量不是政策主张，而是感觉。面团在木桌上发酵，阳光落在亚麻布和铜锅上，母亲从容地为孩子准备食物。画面有意压低现代生活的噪声，把家庭呈现为可以掌控的小世界。它出售的是情绪上的确定性：生活有节奏，劳动有结果，每个人似乎都有清楚的位置。

Kate Scott与Lindsay Day对TikTok上61名自我呈现为Tradwife的创作者发布的102条帖子进行了质性内容分析。她们发现，传统女性气质、宗教服从、母职、生殖未来想象和殖民怀旧，常通过图像、声音与语言共同出现。研究者将85.2%的样本创作者编码为白人，26%的视频出现小型农场。这个非随机样本不能代表TikTok，也不能证明观众会接受其中的价值观；它能够说明一组明确的帖子如何把家庭生活制作成看似自然、宁静的理想。
这种幻想之所以有效，也因为它没有凭空制造不满。美国2024年时间使用调查显示，在有6岁以下儿童的家庭中，女性平均每天用于主要育儿活动3小时，男性为2小时。这些数据不能识别Tradwife观众，也不能解释每个家庭，却说明照护负担仍然分配不均。

blocks.heading_en: A private exit from public exhaustion
blocks.heading_zh: 从公共疲惫中寻找私人出口
paragraphs_en: Women have repeatedly been asked to ‘have it all’: professional success, economic independence, a fulfilling relationship, intensive motherhood, and a constantly presentable self. The Tradwife fantasy offers what looks like a clean exit. Rather than asking women to be ideal workers and ideal mothers at once, it presents withdrawal as a recovery of femininity, family value, and peace.

Sarah Banet-Weiser and Sara Reinis analyzed 50 Tradwife accounts on Instagram and TikTok. They argue that Tradwife discourse and feminist critique encounter three shared material problems: capitalist hustle culture, the devaluation of reproductive labour, and failing systems of care. The disagreement lies in where responsibility is placed. Some Tradwife content blames feminism for drawing women away from home, then offers traditional order as a private solution.

A person may genuinely want to leave a damaging workplace, spend more time caring for children, or arrange family life according to religious belief. None of this automatically constitutes antifeminist politics. But when inadequate childcare, low wages, long hours, and inequality at home are retold as proof that women chose the wrong place, public problems become personal failures—and the proposed exit remains available mainly to households with sufficient income and resources.
paragraphs_zh: 女性被反复要求“拥有一切”：职业成功、经济独立、体面的亲密关系、投入的母职，以及始终可展示的自我。Tradwife幻想提供了一个看似干净的出口。它不再要求女性同时成为理想员工与理想母亲，而是把“退出”描述为找回女性气质、家庭价值和内心平静。
Sarah Banet-Weiser与Sara Reinis分析了Instagram和TikTok上的50个Tradwife账号。她们指出，Tradwife话语与女性主义批评触碰了三项共同的物质问题：资本主义的hustle culture、生殖劳动被贬值，以及照护体系失灵。分歧在于责任被放在哪里。部分Tradwife内容把疲惫归因于女性主义让女性离开家庭，再把传统秩序作为私人解决方案。
一个人可能真诚地想离开有害职场、更多照顾孩子，或依照宗教信仰安排家庭生活。这些选择并不自动构成反女权政治。可是，当缺少托育、低工资、超长工时和家庭不平等被重新讲述为“女人选错了位置”，公共问题就被改写成个人失败；这个出口也主要向拥有足够收入和资源的家庭开放。

blocks.heading_en: Escaping work by turning domesticity into work
blocks.heading_zh: 以逃离工作为承诺，把家庭生活变成工作
paragraphs_en: Sophia Sykes and Veronica Hopner conducted a ten-month netnography of 36 Tradwife social-media accounts in 2022. One of the four themes they identified was the ‘Tradwife side-hustle.’ Thirty-five of the 36 accounts used some form of monetization, including advertising, brand partnerships, online programmes, or small businesses.

The sample came from what the researchers defined as a right-wing Tradwife community, so it cannot represent all homemakers or show that every Tradwife earns substantial income. It does reveal that the ‘not working’ shown on camera may combine cooking, cleaning, childcare, and emotional maintenance with planning, filming, editing, posting, analytics, persona management, and sponsorships. The home becomes both living space and studio.

Caro Claire Burke’s 2026 novel Yesteryear turns this contradiction into a cultural thought experiment. Its protagonist Natalie is wife, mother, and influencer; behind her displayed traditional home are a nanny, a producer, farmworkers, and modern equipment kept outside the frame. The novel cannot prove that real creators conceal teams. It dramatizes a useful question: when domesticity looks effortless, which workers, technologies, and resources have disappeared from view?
paragraphs_zh: Sophia Sykes与Veronica Hopner在2022年对36个Tradwife社交媒体账号进行了10个月网络民族志。她们归纳出的四个主题之一就是“Tradwife side-hustle”。36个账号中有35个存在某种变现方式，包括广告、品牌合作、线上项目或小企业。
样本来自研究者界定的右派Tradwife社群，因此不能代表所有家庭主妇，也不能说明每位Tradwife都获得可观收入。它揭示的是，镜头中的“不工作”可能同时包含烹饪、清洁、育儿和情绪维持，也包含选题、拍摄、剪辑、发布、查看数据、维持人设与商业合作。家庭既是生活空间，也是摄影棚。
Caro Claire Burke的2026年小说《Yesteryear》把这组矛盾变成文化思想实验。主人公Natalie同时是妻子、母亲和网红，她展示的传统家庭背后有保姆、制片人、农工和藏在镜头外的现代设备。小说不能证明现实创作者都隐藏团队，却戏剧化地提出了一个有用的问题：当家庭生活显得毫不费力时，哪些劳动者、技术与资源消失了？

blocks.heading_en: A personal arrangement is not a universal rule
blocks.heading_zh: 私人安排不是普遍规则
paragraphs_en: ‘This is my choice’ is one of the strongest claims in Tradwife content. Personal choice is real: people may prefer caregiving, accept religious divisions of roles, or leave paid work because of childcare costs, health, or workplace conditions. Private arrangements should not automatically be stigmatized.

Choice does not occur in a vacuum. Income, housing, partnership, childcare costs, legal protection, and family support shape which options are feasible. More importantly, ‘I choose this’ is not the same as ‘women are naturally meant for this.’ The first describes a personal arrangement; the second turns one arrangement into a normative place for women.

Rebecca Stotzer and Ashley Nelson analyzed how 60 self-identified Tradwives on TikTok explained entering the lifestyle. The study brings creators’ accounts into the discussion, but public self-presentation is not a complete life history and cannot measure national prevalence. There is currently no reliable national survey estimating how many women identify as Tradwives.
paragraphs_zh: “这是我的选择”是Tradwife内容中最有力量的主张之一。个人选择真实存在：有人偏好家庭照护，有人接受宗教分工，也有人因托育成本、健康或工作环境离开职场。私人安排不应自动受到污名化。
但选择并不发生在真空中。收入、住房、伴侣关系、托育价格、法律保障与家庭支持，都会决定哪些选择真正可行。更重要的是，“我选择这样生活”与“女人天生应该这样生活”不是同一主张。前者描述个人安排；后者把一种安排变成所有女性的规范位置。
Rebecca Stotzer与Ashley Nelson分析了60名在TikTok上自认Tradwife的创作者如何解释自己进入这种生活。研究让创作者自述进入讨论，但公开的自我呈现不等于完整生活史，也不能测量全国规模。目前没有可靠的全国调查能够估计有多少女性自认Tradwife。

blocks.heading_en: An anti-modern fantasy built by modern platforms
blocks.heading_zh: 由现代平台建造的反现代幻想
paragraphs_en: Tradwife culture appears to reject modernity, yet depends on modern platforms and commercial systems. TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube distribute it; recommendation systems expand exposure; comments create community; parasocial relationships make viewers feel they know the family; advertising, affiliate links, courses, and products convert intimacy into income.

Eviane Leidig’s 2023 book The Women of the Far Right studies women influencers explicitly situated in the far right. She shows how dating, food, home, pregnancy, and motherhood can be mixed with white-nationalist, antifeminist, or conspiratorial narratives. Politics may enter not as a speech, but through a relatable persona offering everyday advice.

Leidig’s work explains how lifestyle can carry politics, but cannot be generalized into ‘all Tradwives are far right.’ Platforms may amplify content, reward clear identities, and make narratives feel ordinary without algorithms single-handedly turning viewers into extremists. Exposure, identification, attitude change, and political action are different questions.
paragraphs_zh: Tradwife文化看似拒绝现代性，却依赖现代平台与商业系统。TikTok、Instagram和YouTube提供分发，推荐系统扩大接触，评论区制造社群，拟社会关系让观众觉得自己熟悉屏幕中的家庭；广告、联盟链接、课程和产品则把亲近感变成收入。
Eviane Leidig于2023年出版的《The Women of the Far Right》研究的是明确属于极右翼的女性网红。她说明，约会、食物、家庭、怀孕和母职内容如何与白人民族主义、反女权或阴谋论叙事混合。政治不一定以演讲出现，也可能借由可亲近的人设进入日常建议。
Leidig的研究能够解释生活方式如何承载政治，却不能被外推为“所有Tradwife都是极右翼”。平台可以放大内容、奖励鲜明身份并让叙事显得日常，却不能据此说算法单独把观众变成极端主义者。接触、认同、态度变化与政治行动是不同的问题。

blocks.heading_en: When lifestyle becomes a social order
blocks.heading_zh: 生活方式何时成为社会秩序
paragraphs_en: The political threshold is not bread, dresses, or the number of children, but how content explains society. Baking is not a political identity, and full-time care is not evidence of the far right. Responsible judgment requires repeated claims, self-description, organizational ties, or explicit antifeminist, nationalist, racialized pronatalist, or conspiratorial content.

Sykes and Hopner located accounts across different positions on the right, from conservative right to alt-lite and alt-right, and found no two accounts identical. Pilyarchuk and Graf’s exploratory analysis of 11 North American sociopolitical influencer accounts examines how Tradwife identity is performed through image, language, impression management, and authenticity. Its small selected sample can identify strategies but cannot describe all domestic Instagram content.

Some politicized creators use domestic aesthetics to lower the threshold for political messages, presenting gender hierarchy as common sense, healing, or personal growth. Other creators share visual symbols without sharing the same ideology. Political normalization is a possibility, not an outcome produced by every view.
paragraphs_zh: 判断政治性的关键并不是面包、裙子或孩子数量，而是内容如何解释社会。喜欢烘焙不是政治身份，选择全职照护也不是极右翼证据。可靠判断需要反复表达的主张、自我描述、组织关联，或明确的反女权、民族主义、种族化生育与阴谋论内容。
Sykes与Hopner把账号放在右派内部不同位置，从保守右派到alt-lite和alt-right，没有两个账号完全相同。Pilyarchuk与Graf对11个北美社会政治网红账号所做的探索性分析，考察Tradwife身份如何通过图像、语言、印象管理和“真实感”被表演。这个小型选定样本可以辨认策略，却不能描述所有Instagram家庭内容。
部分政治化创作者使用家庭美学降低政治语言的进入门槛，把性别等级呈现为常识、疗愈或个人成长；另一些创作者可能只共享视觉符号，并不共享相同意识形态。政治正常化是一种可能性，不是每次观看都会发生的结果。

blocks.heading_en: Flowers do not automatically lead to fascism
blocks.heading_zh: 花朵不会自动通向法西斯主义
paragraphs_en: Oliver Mel Allen, Yi Zu, Milo Z. Trujillo, and Brooke Foucault Welles analyzed more than 200,000 Tumblr posts and content-coded roughly 2,350. They did not find a clear user-radicalization pipeline from cottagecore to Tradwife content. They found a more limited mainstreaming risk: overlapping communities, increasing traditional-gender and religious tags, and political content adapted to appear softer within platform norms. They also found more queer–Tradwife interaction and anti-racist expression than expected.

The study is limited to Tumblr and did not track individual browsing histories or attitude change. It can neither prove radicalization nor rule out pathways elsewhere. It does reject a deterministic story in which searching for flowers or bread automatically leads to fascism.

The label itself is contested. The New Yorker reported that early Tradwife identifier Alena Kate Pettitt later left Instagram and distanced herself from the term while continuing to value homemaking. Hopner and Sykes’s research distinguishes rejecting the label while retaining a traditional domestic life from rejecting the life itself. Nara Smith has described herself as a working mom, while reliable evidence does not establish that Hannah Neeleman adopts the label. Media classification is not self-identification; aesthetic resemblance is not political proof.
paragraphs_zh: Oliver Mel Allen、Yi Zu、Milo Z. Trujillo与Brooke Foucault Welles分析了超过20万条Tumblr帖子，并对约2350条进行内容编码。他们没有发现从cottagecore到Tradwife内容的清晰用户激进化流水线。研究发现的是更有限的主流化风险：社群重叠，传统性别和宗教标签增加，政治内容也可能适应平台规范而显得更温和。研究还发现了比预期更多的queer—Tradwife互动和反种族主义表达。
研究只针对Tumblr，也没有追踪个人浏览轨迹或态度变化，因此既不能证明激进化，也不能排除其他地方的路径。但它反驳了搜索花朵或面包会自动把人带向法西斯主义的决定论故事。

标签本身也在被争夺。《纽约客》报道，早期使用Tradwife身份的Alena Kate Pettitt后来退出Instagram并疏离该词，却仍重视家庭主妇角色。Hopner与Sykes的研究区分了“拒绝标签但保留传统家庭生活”和“拒绝生活本身”。Nara Smith称自己是working mom，也没有可靠证据证明Hannah Neeleman主动采用Tradwife标签。媒体归类不是自我认同，审美相似也不是政治证据。

blocks.heading_en: The past is a collage, not a destination
blocks.heading_zh: 过去是一幅拼贴，而不是一个目的地
paragraphs_en: The past summoned by Tradwife culture combines the consumer kitchen of the 1950s, pioneer self-sufficiency, modern medical safety, contemporary appliances, and social-media commerce. It keeps clear roles and beautiful images while deleting intensive labour, legal constraints, class difference, and bodily risk.

The U.S. Census Bureau’s review of the 1950 Census reports that 29% of roughly 57 million working-age women were in the labour force, including 46.4% of single women and 21.6% of married women. The postwar homemaker model had real institutional power but never encompassed all women. Lower participation cannot be read as universal satisfaction: exclusion from employment, care responsibilities, and social norms shaped access to paid work.

The claim that women ‘did not work’ also reduces work to wages. Fetching water and fuel, preserving food, laundry, childcare, and care for the sick did not vanish because no wage was paid. Smithsonian materials describe nineteenth-century laundry as collecting water and fuel, washing and wringing by hand, drying, and heating heavy irons on a stove. Comfortable vintage reenactment now relies on indoor plumbing, electricity, refrigeration, transport, and modern medicine.

Class is equally important. A single male income, land, a large kitchen, equipment, and extensive food preparation require resources; some historical middle- and upper-class households relied on domestic servants, laundresses, and farmworkers excluded from the family portrait. Historical CDC data also show how profoundly medical infrastructure changed reproductive risk: in the early twentieth-century United States, roughly six to nine women died from pregnancy-related complications per 1,000 live births. This is not an 1855 estimate or a current rate; it demonstrates that nostalgia cannot detach birth from material history.
paragraphs_zh: Tradwife文化召唤的“过去”把1950年代消费家庭的厨房、先锋生活的自给自足、现代医学的安全、当代电器的便利和社交媒体商业拼在一起。它保留明确角色与漂亮画面，同时删去高强度劳动、法律限制、阶级差异和身体风险。
美国人口普查局对1950年人口普查的回顾显示，在约5700万劳动年龄女性中，29%进入劳动力市场；单身女性为46.4%，已婚女性为21.6%。战后家庭主妇模式确实拥有制度力量，却从未覆盖所有女性。较低的劳动参与率也不能被理解为普遍满意，因为就业排斥、照护责任与社会规范都会影响有薪工作的机会。
“女性过去不工作”还把工作错误地缩减为工资。取水、取燃料、储藏食物、洗衣、育儿和照护病人，并不会因为没有工资而消失。史密森尼资料记录了19世纪洗衣所需的取水取燃料、手洗手拧、晾晒，以及用炉火加热重型熨斗。现代复古生活之所以可以舒适重演，依赖室内供水、电力、冷藏、交通和现代医学。
阶级同样重要。单一男性收入、土地、宽敞厨房、设备和大量自制食物都需要资源；一些历史上的中上阶层家庭还依赖被家庭肖像排除的女佣、洗衣工和农工。CDC历史资料也说明医疗基础设施如何改变生育风险：20世纪初美国每1000次活产约有6至9名女性死于妊娠相关并发症。这不是1855年的估计，也不是今天的死亡率；它说明怀旧不能把生育与物质历史割裂。

blocks.heading_zh: 这场幻想最终出售的是什么
paragraphs_en: The fantasy is seductive because it compresses contemporary desires into one legible image: rest from overwork, renewed meaning for care, escape from permanent competition, a stable family, and a predictable identity. It makes structural problems appear solvable through personal lifestyle.

Yet the exit can conceal unpaid and content labour, depend on a partner’s income and class resources, reprivatize failures of care, and—in politicized versions—cast feminism as the problem. The evidence supports neither ‘Tradwife is freedom’ nor ‘Tradwife is the far right.’ A more defensible conclusion is that Tradwife culture can turn structural exhaustion into an individualized fantasy of return, while remaining politically varied and not automatically radicalizing.

The questions that matter are not whether a woman bakes bread, wears a long dress, or chooses to stay home. They are who performs care, who has economic security, which forms of labour remain visible, and when a personal arrangement is repackaged as an order all women are expected to obey.
paragraphs_zh: 这场幻想之所以迷人，是因为它把几种当代渴望压缩成一幅容易理解的画面：从过劳中休息，让照护重新获得意义，摆脱持续竞争，拥有稳定家庭和可预测身份。它让结构性问题看起来可以通过个人生活方式解决。
但这个出口可能隐藏无偿劳动和内容劳动，依赖伴侣收入与阶级资源，把照护危机重新私有化，并在政治化版本中把女性主义塑造成问题。证据既不支持“Tradwife就是自由”，也不支持“Tradwife就是极右翼”。更可辩护的结论是：Tradwife文化可以把结构性疲惫转化成个人化的回归幻想，但它在政治上并不统一，也不会自动使人激进化。
真正值得追问的，不是一个女人是否烤面包、穿长裙或选择留在家中，而是谁承担照护，谁拥有经济保障，哪些劳动被看见，以及个人安排何时被包装成所有女性都应服从的秩序。

journalism.author: Sophie Elmhirst
